name: size of ck3.exe
counting_rule: file size in bytes; changes with every game update and is the key under which fields and model are stored

name: RTTI type names in the list on disk
counting_rule: lines in the file check_rtti.ps1 produced, one per unique name, deduplicated case sensitively

name: RTTI type names according to memory.py
counting_rule: memory.type_name_count() on the same exe; equal to check_rtti.ps1 since that script started deduplicating case sensitively on 30 July 2026

name: widget vtables in the exe
counting_rule: vtables of classes descending from CPdxGuiWidget; 52 classes, two of which have two through multiple inheritance

name: gui files, game layer
counting_rule: files with the gui suffix under game\gui, all subfolders included

name: gui files, engine layer
counting_rule: the same under clausewitz\gui

name: gui files, jomini layer
counting_rule: the same under the whole jomini folder: 91 in jomini\gui plus the encyclopedia in jomini\jomini\gui, which a count on jomini\gui alone would miss

name: gui files in the game folder, total
counting_rule: every file with the gui suffix under the game folder: 373 game layer, 49 engine layer, 92 jomini layer and one developer file for the tweaker; this count is not tied to a folder and therefore cannot go quietly too low

name: English localization files
counting_rule: files with the yml suffix under localization\english, all subfolders included

name: lines in shortcuts.shortcuts
counting_rule: lines in the main file; the seven smaller files in the engine and editor layers do not count

name: map_data\positions.txt
counting_rule: file size in bytes

name: map_data\definition.csv
counting_rule: file size in bytes

name: map_data\adjacencies.csv
counting_rule: file size in bytes

name: 00_landed_titles.txt
counting_rule: file size in bytes

name: channel.dll
counting_rule: file size in bytes; changes with every rebuild of the DLL

name: derived field offsets
counting_rule: fields in fields.json besides the four bookkeeping keys; the seven layout offsets plus alpha and the window flag, which have been derived by toggling a window since 24 August 2026

name: record length of a character
counting_rule: from model.json

name: characters per block
counting_rule: from model.json

name: stride between blocks
counting_rule: from model.json; 1024 times 464 is 475136, so a 16-byte header per block

name: model field culture
counting_rule: offset relative to the handle field, from model.json

name: model field faith
counting_rule: offset relative to the handle field, from model.json

name: model field dynasty house
counting_rule: offset relative to the handle field, from model.json

name: game state in the Bohemia save
counting_rule: unpacked size of gamestate in MB to one decimal; the file itself is 7751963 bytes

name: game state in the Ghur save
counting_rule: the same; the file itself is 7179229 bytes and its header is 23007 bytes, not 32720 as in the Bohemia save

name: expansions on disk
counting_rule: one metadata file with the dlc suffix per expansion folder; all 29 are enabled, because disabled_dlcs in dlc_load.json is empty

name: enabled mods
counting_rule: reference files in the mod folder, each pointing at a workshop folder; dlc_load.json names the same five

name: game state in the Nobatia save
counting_rule: unpacked size of gamestate in MB to one decimal; made 23 August 2026 with five mods and every expansion, against 60.7 and 56.7 for the two vanilla saves

name: gui files of the five mods
counting_rule: files with the gui suffix under the CK3 workshop folder; RICE 67, Historical Figure 1, Historic Invasions 1, and none of them replaces a vanilla file

name: files that go into the repo
counting_rule: files under the project folder that .gitignore does not exclude; on 23 August 2026 git ls-files --others --exclude-standard counted the same number. 45 until 25 August 2026, when the click round added tools/ck3/openers.py and reports/openers.json; 48 when the gui reader added tools/ck3/guimap.py; 47 when docsearch.py was taken out, because it reads only the working notes; 50 since the NVDA sleep-mode add-on added three files under tools/nvda/addon; 52 since the alignment added tools/ck3/pairing.py and reports/pairing.json; 53 since the database reader added tools/ck3/database.py

name: windows opened in the harvest round
counting_rule: records in harvest\ with opened true; 18 of the 196 windows in the map refuse to open at all, the same 18 as in the round before

name: text boxes in the harvest round
counting_rule: summed over the records: text boxes of a window that carry text, are not clipped, have no zero alpha above them and lie inside the drawing area, so they should be on screen

name: text boxes the recogniser confirmed
counting_rule: summed over the records: of those boxes, the ones an overlapping recognised line says the same thing about. 1156 of 1261 in the round of 26 August 2026. harvest\ is outside the repo, so on a clone these measure nothing and drift - they belong to a round on one machine

name: text boxes outside the drawing area
counting_rule: summed over the records: boxes that would otherwise count, but fall wholly or partly outside the 1600x900 drawing area. A window built by GUI.CreateWidget is not laid out where a player would see it, so counting these as misses measures the console route rather than the recogniser

name: windows in the map that a mod put there
counting_rule: entries in windows.json whose gui file exists in none of the three game layers (game, clausewitz, jomini); the map ships, so anything a mod added would be a window nobody else can open

name: gui files as the engine sees them, vanilla
counting_rule: the three layers merged on their shared virtual path, so a file the game layer replaces is counted once: 374 game, 71 jomini, 49 engine. Lower than the 515 counted on disk because 21 virtual paths exist in two layers

name: gui files as the engine sees them, with mods
counting_rule: the same with the five enabled mods on top; the 69 mod files all add and none of them replaces a vanilla virtual path

name: global gui templates
counting_rule: distinct names declared as `type` or `template` in the merged set, later declarations winning; both keywords reach across files, which is why they share one table

name: file-local gui templates
counting_rule: names declared as `local_type`, keyed by file; all six sit in the developers' editor tools

name: windows with a name in the merged gui set
counting_rule: `window = { name = ... }` blocks found by the parser in the merged set, at any depth and one entry per name. windows.json holds 197: its line reader met a window block carrying no name in frontend_load.gui and walked on to the next name it saw, which belongs to the template vbox_save_preview, so load_info is in the map and is not a window. Of these 196, 195 can be created with GUI.CreateWidget; colorpicker_window cannot, because that block sits inside a type definition and the console finds only top-level widgets

name: harvested widgets that carry text
counting_rule: every widget with a non-empty text in the 178 harvested trees, counted while walking, and the walk asserts it saw all 68110 widgets of every record; a live subtree whose parent found no source used to be skipped, which shrank this denominator by dropping exactly the hard cases

name: harvested texts paired with a place in a gui file
counting_rule: paired by class and child order only, never by name. 165 of them are a caption: a button carries its own text and the engine hangs a text box under it to draw it, so the box is not in the file and the widget above answers for it. The remaining 137 are texts the files describe nowhere, and 76 of those sit in developer windows - the debug map, the AI watch windows, the component library

name: harvested texts whose gui file names a plain localization key
counting_rule: a text key that is in the localization and whose value holds neither a data function nor a quote of another key. DEFAULT_TEXT is counted apart because it is a placeholder for text the code sets

name: plain keys whose localization matches what was on screen
counting_rule: the check that can fail: game markup stripped from the screen text, style markup and icon tokens from the localization, then compared whole. All 547 agree, which is also what carries the caption model - had a button's caption not been the source of the box under it, those 165 would have disagreed

name: harvested texts filled by a data function
counting_rule: 163 where the gui file carries the call itself and 166 where it carries a key whose localization does; both need the data context of the ancestors to say who the sentence is about

name: harvested texts the gui file leaves to code
counting_rule: the widget carries DEFAULT_TEXT, so the files positively cannot say what will stand there and only a running game can; this is an answer, not a gap

name: HasDlcFeature checks in the merged gui set
counting_rule: every HasDlcFeature('x') in the 563 merged files, counted by text. All 45 sit on the visible of a widget: expanded over all 196 windows on 27 August 2026, not one window block carries such a check, so an expansion never takes a window away from a tester, only parts inside one

name: distinct expansion features the gui set gates on
counting_rule: distinct names inside those calls, by text over the files. Eleven of the thirteen are reachable from the expansion of a named window; admin_gov sits in the bookmark screen and court_room_view in the hud, neither of which is a window in the map. all_under_heaven reaches 114 of the 117 affected windows through three shared portrait templates and hides one status icon; the other ten touch one to five windows each. Feature names match expansion titles - all_under_heaven is All Under Heaven, dlc022_ep4 - but most are named for the feature and not the expansion, so that mapping is not derivable from disk

name: cultures the engine loads
counting_rule: top-level keys in common/culture/cultures, game folder first and the five mods after it in load order, a file replacing the one at the same name. 244 without the mods; RICE brings most of the rest

name: cultures that also have a name in the localization
counting_rule: of those keys, the ones the localization files also carry a sentence for. All of them, which is the check that the reader read the right part of the file rather than a plausible-looking wrong one

name: faiths the engine loads
counting_rule: a faith is not a top-level key: it hangs inside a religion under `faiths`, in common/religion/religion_types, and there is no `religions` folder at all. A line reader looking at column zero finds none of them. 140 without the mods
